name: Kettlebell Single-Arm Clean and Press
steps: Stand over one kettlebell with feet shoulder-width apart, hinge at your hips, and grip the handle with one hand.
Hike the bell back between your thighs and snap your hips forward to clean it smoothly into the front rack position.
Brace your abs and glutes, pack your shoulder down, and press the kettlebell straight overhead until your arm locks out.
Lower the bell under control back to the rack and swing into the next clean, switching arms after finishing one side.
tips: Keep your elbow tucked close to your ribs during the clean so the kettlebell settles softly onto your forearm.
Avoid leaning sideways or arching your lower back as you press the kettlebell overhead.
